title: Pale Pumpkins
description: The White Pumpkin sends her regards... (Resource Pack)
body:
A resource pack that brings the White Pumpkins from Minecraft: Story Mode – Episode 6 (_A Portal to Mystery_) into the game.

### Current features
_As of version 1.0.0_
- White Pumpkins
- Carved White Pumpkins
- White Jack o'Lanterns
- White Pumpkin Seeds
- White Pumpkin Pie
- Compatibility with dialects of French and English
- Compatibility with all joke languages

### Planned features
_Features marked with an asterisk are in beta_
- Compatibility with [Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts)*
- Custom textures for the carved pumpkin when worn, using [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)
- Further language compatibility
- White Pumpkin paintings*
- Updated White Pumpkin Pie texture
- [LabPBR](https://shaderlabs.org/wiki/LabPBR_Supported_Packs) emissive textures
